body.body:

- Blur media thumbnails in reply quotes and the chat list.
- Hide caller profile on lock screen when notification previews are hidden.

Get your badge: https://simplex.chat/badges/

body.name: v7.1.0-beta.5
body.body:
New in v7.1.0-beta.5.

- Alert when supporter badge renewal fails.
- Add link to SimpleX Network News channel in settings.
- Fix connecting via contact cards.

Android and desktop:
- Open member profiles without delay.
- Reduce CPU use of media blur and apply it on Android 11 and older.

Desktop:
- Fix crash at startup on Windows.
- Fix app locking after calls.
- Fix freeze when stopping a video.
- Fix slow scrolling with blurred bars.

Get your badge: https://simplex.chat/badges/

- blog: update image
- website: update cf page (#7549)

New in v7.1-beta.1:
  - change receiving address when current server is offline.
  - auto-accept group invitations - you can enable it in Privacy & security settings, disabled by default.
 
Fixed:
  - slow opening of member profiles in large groups (Android and desktop).
  - stretched video preview and playback (desktop).
  - profile renamed to a name that is already used.
  - creating a profile with a name in use deactivated all profiles.

We launched equity crowdfunding on Wefunder: https://simplex.chat/blog/20260819-simplex-chat-crowdfunding.html

body.body:
New in v7.0.1.

You can get a stake in SimpleX Chat – we launched [equity crowdfunding on Wefunder](https://wefunder.com/simplex.chat).

Send .webm files as videos (Android and desktop).

body.name: v7.0.0-beta.6
body.body:
New in v7.0-beta.6:
- remove the "SimpleX Status" contact from new chat profiles.
- fixes:
  - improve message forwarding in groups
  - ios: fix app crash after finishing onboarding.
  - ios: fix delivery receipt toggles in privacy settings.
  - desktop: don't lose the app update download when switching chats.
  - linux: fix saving files with special characters

Commits:
- blog: SimpleX public names (#7291)
- blog: corrections
- blog: correction
- core: reject group message forwards from unexpected admins (#7289)
- core: prohibit to change or assign relay role (#7284)
- core: fix member support chats staying marked unread after they're read (#7281)
- desktop: fix saving files with '[', '*', or '?' in name on Linux (#7290)
- core: remove SimpleX Status preset contact (#7231)
- core: prohibit image previews when images are prohibited (#7296)
- ios: put "connect to name" button below search in top bar layout (#7297)
- ios: fix receipts toggles in user settings (#7298)
- ios: fix app crashing after onboarding (#7299)
- ui: rename "how to register name" button (#7300)
- desktop: fix chat switch deleting the in-app updater's download (#7295)
- core: ignore mentions and replies of blocked members (#7303)
- directory: expand service README (#6701)
- support bot: fix double invite when joining a customer chat (#7129)
- core: 7.0.0.11 (simplexmq 7.0.0.6)
- desktop: fix opening contact request leaving previous open chat in connecting state (#7302)
- ios: update core library
- website: translations (#7306)
- ui: translations (#7305)
- ui: update whats new
- ios: build 344
- 7.0.0-beta.6: android 365, desktop 154

body.body:
New in v7.0-beta.5:

- enable/disable functions of self-hosted servers: message reception, private routing, and name resolution.
- show file routers used to deliver a file in message info.
- fixes:
  - desktop: preserve a draft when switching to a chat where you can't send messages.
  - android: video previews layout

- core: allow moderators to change member <-> observer roles in groups (#7279)

- 7.0.0.10

body.name: v7.0.0-beta.4
body.body:
New in v7.0-beta.4:

- support for signing messages in channels (disabled until 7.1).
- verify a channel member's security code to confirm the connection isn't intercepted.
- add a longer description to your profile.
- search the subscribers list in a channel.
- fix: desktop no longer fails to launch on Windows when accessibility is enabled.

Commits:
- website: update whitepaper
- simplex-chat: sync nodejs and python libs with 7.0.0-beta.3 types (#7219)
- core: don't create group-only feature items in channels (#7220)
- ios: show spinner for database operations moved to sub-screen (#7228)
- multiplatform: improve image processing (#7082)
- core, ui: improve name resolution (#7209)
- core, ui: message signing (#7115)
- core: update query plans
- multiplatform: bound shared file URI copies  (#7075)
- core, ui: show domain for business chat in CLI, test, improve UI (#7235)
- core, web: correctly process name verification for channels, show names in directory (#7238)
- directory: fix group link verification (#7242)
- tests: create separate tmp folders for test clients (#7244)
- ui: hide message signing preference, etc. (#7246)
- core, ui: make msgVerified optional (#7247)
- ci: update query plans
- docs: names overview (#7253)
- docs: add name resolution setup to SMP server guide (#7251)
- website: fix broken GitHub links for project files in docs (#7229)
- cli: add name, image and relay server address flags (#6944)
- core, ui: security code verification in channels (verify member key) (#7255)
- core: add optional profile description (#7256)
- bots api
- ui: add search to subscribers list view; android, desktop: lazy list (#7264)
- desktop: fix "Failed to launch JVM" on Windows when Java Access Bridge is enabled (one cause of #4146) (#7260)
- ui: what's new in 7.0 (#7265)
- desktop: show startup errors in a copyable window instead of bare "Failed to launch JVM" (#7261)
- website: add Chat Relay guide to the docs navbar (#7271)
- desktop: fix low-quality image previews from over-downsampling (#7267)
- docs: add Hosting your own Chat Relay guide (#7272)
- core: signed history in channels, auto-sign based on preference (#7257)
- core: 7.0.0.9 (simplexmq 7.0.0.5)
- ui: improve profile descriptions (#7262)
- ios: export localizations
- ios, desktop, android: clearer error message when connecting via removed link (AUTH) (#7268)
- desktop: show only desktop .deb packages for current architecture in updater (#7270)
- website: translations (#7273)
- android, desktop: fix empty area below wide images (beta.3 regression) (#7223)
- ui: translations (#7275)
- desktop: don't delete shared temp dirs from a transient second instance (#7168)

body.name: v7.0.0-beta.3
body.body:
New in v7.0-beta.3:
- SimpleX names for channels and businesses:
  - register the name at https://testing-names.simplex.chat/ (requires SimpleX NFT for the next week).
  - try these names in search: #simiplexchat.testing and @directory.testing     
  - see the guide at: https://github.com/simplex-chat/simplex-chat/blob/master/docs/guide/register-simplex-name.md
- Improve stability of connections between members in groups.
- improve management of contributor role in channels.

body.name: v7.0.0-beta.0
body.body:
New in v7.0-beta.0:

- channel web previews: read recent posts before joining.
- channel owners can add and remove relays.
- option to delete a removed member's messages.
- more reliable message delivery in groups.
- faster loading of large groups.
- reorganized settings, with new section design on Android and desktop.
- initial support for supporter badges.

body.body:

- allow deleting messages from channel history without time limit.
- support adding and removing chat relays in channels on the subscriber side (will be enabled in UI in v6.5.x or v7).

- flatpak: update metainfo (#6943)

body.name: v6.5.0
body.body:
New in v6.5. Public channels - speak freely! - Reliability: many relays per channel. - Ownership: you can run your own relays. - Security: owners hold channel keys. - Privacy: for owners and subscribers. Easier to invite your friends: we made connecting simpler for new users. Safe web links: - opt-in to send link previews. - use SOCKS proxy for previews (if enabled). - prevent hyperlink phishing. - remove link tracking. Non-profit governance: to make SimpleX Network last. body.name: v6.5.0-beta.10
body.body:
What's new in v6.5-beta.10
- simpler to invite and connect for the new users.
- channel preferences
- sharing of channel links.
- opt-in link previews.
- fixes and improvements.

New in v6.5-beta.7:
- public channels based on chat relays (BETA).
- faster and more stable initial connection, especially on bad networks.
- reduced memory usage by ~30%.
- fix opening chats on new unread items (after sent or viewed items).
- android, desktop: fix navigating to quoted message in search and content filter.
- desktop:
  - select text in messages.
  - support sending voice messages.
  - improve voice and video playback stability.
  
**Please note**: mobile apps can be linked only with the same version desktop app.

body.name: v6.5.0-beta.2
body.body:
New in v6.5-beta.2:
- improved moderation:
  - allow to hide member profile and optionally remove sent messages after member is removed or left (via "block" function).
  - allow removing all member messages.
- fix deleting chat with member.
- reduce database size for group admins (the space will be freed up after the next release).
- Android, desktop: fix stuck message reception and other events after passphrase change (e.g., during desktop app initial start).
- iOS: reduce memory usage when sharing to SimpleX app.

body.name: v6.4.4-beta.0
body.body:
New in v6.4.4-beta.0:
- substantial reduction of battery usage in instant notifications mode - but please watch if some notifications are lost when phone is in background/fully idle - also known as "deep sleep".
- ugrade to Android SDK 35, Jetpack Compose to 1.8.2.
- improve "cleaning" of web links.
- fixes:
  - ignore events in deleted contacts and groups.
  - member contact requests not showing incognito.
  - business address prohibiting files.
  - deletion of members and groups not forwarded to some members.
  - error when creating group link.

body.name: v6.4.1-beta.0
body.body:
New in v6.4.1-beta.0:
- allow to choose default time to delete for disappearing messages in user profile - it is applied as override to new contacts only.
- profile bio and short group description.
- welcome message for contact address without auto-accept.
- short link improvements: profile images, bio/short description, and welcome messages are shown before connecting.
- chat "banner" shown in new conversations.
- support retrying connection via contact cards (Ask SimpleX team and Status bot).
- Flux servers are enabled by default as proxy for the new users.
- faster loading of the chat list.

Read about the new UX for making connections in the blog post: https://simplex.chat/blog/20250703-simplex-network-protocol-extension-for-securely-connecting-people.html

Commits:
- flatpak: update metainfo (#6085)
- github/workflows: fix reproduce schedule (#6075)
- docs: code of conduct (#6084)

body.name: v6.4.0
body.body:
New in v6.4:
- Connect faster: message instantly once you tap Connect.
- Review group members: chat with new members before they join.
- Chat with admins: send your private feedback to group owners.
- New group role: Moderator - can remove messages and block members.
- Improved message delivery - less traffic on mobile networks.

Read about the new UX for making connections in the blog post: https://simplex.chat/blog/20250703-simplex-network-protocol-extension-for-securely-connecting-people.html

body.name: v6.4.0-beta.4
body.body:
New in v6.4-beta.4:

**Fully redesigned UX for**:
- making connections via 1-time invitations and contact addresses.
- joining groups.

**How it worked before**:
- you receive a long (~300-500 characters) invitation link that looked like malware to some users.
- you tap the link and then tap connect - you could only choose incognito or current profile, but could not switch profiles.
- you see "connecting" until your contact is online.

It was a broken UX for most people, so we fixed it!

**How it works now**:
- you receive a short (~70-100 characters), but as secure link (more secure for 1-time invitations).
- scan the link, see the profile or the group name (the profile picture will be shown in v6.4.1).
- tap "Open new chat" / "Open new group"
- in v6.4.1 you will see a group's or contact's welcome message before connecting.
- optionally, switch profile or choose incognito mode.
- for contact addresses, you can optionally add message to connection request.
- tap "Connect" / "Join"

For 1-time invitations you can send messages straight after connecting - no need to wait until the user who created a link is online.

When connecting via contact address it is recommended to include the message, as you will only be able to send more messages after your contact accepts your request.

When joining the group, for connection to complete, the admin that created a group link should be online, so it's recommended that links are created by always-online clients. This limitation will be removed this year.

body.name: v6.3.4
body.body:
New in v6.3.4:
- fixes mentions with trailing punctuation (e.g., `hello @name!`).
- recognizes domain names as links (e.g., `simplex.chat`).
- forward compatibility with "knocking" (a feature for group admins to review and to chat with the new members prior to admitting them to groups, it will be released in 6.4)
- iOS improvements:
  - lots of fixes and improvements for notifications.
  - fixes bugs from Xcode 16 migration - tapping links, opening images, etc.
  - opening the links in the browser/any other apps now requires confirmation in all cases.
  - secrets in messages (e.g.,  `#hidden secret#`): shown on tap one by one, new design.

body.name: v6.3.3
body.body:
New in v6.3.3:

- support for connecting via short connection links.

To create short connection links:
- enable Dev Tools,
- enable short links in Privacy & Security settings.

Only this and later versions of the app will be able to connect via these short links. Full links compatible with the previous versions are created at the same time, and you can choose which of the links to share.

Please note: if you use self-hosted servers, you need to migrate them to server [v6.4.0-beta.1](https://github.com/simplex-chat/simplexmq/releases/tag/v6.4.0-beta.1) or later.

body.name: v6.3.0
body.body:
New in v6.3:

Better groups.
- Mention members and get notified when mentioned.
- Send private reports to moderators.
- Delete, block and change role for multiple members at once (Android and desktop only).
- Faster sending messages and faster deletion.

Better chat navigation
- Organize chats into lists to keep track of what's important.
- Jump to found and forwarded messages.

Better privacy and security.
- Private media file names.
- Message expiration in chats.

Read more on March 8: https://simplex.chat/blog/20250308-simplex-chat-v6-3-new-user-experience-safety-in-public-groups.html

body.name: v6.3.0-beta.2
body.body:
New in v6.3-beta.2:
- send mentions, mentions-only notification mode for groups.
- support on-device message expiration per chat.
- send reports to group moderators.
- fast group deletion.
- to keep original filename private, use timestamp as video filename.
- support connecting to SMP servers via port 443 (via Advanced network settings).

Commits:
- blog: update
- flatpak: update metainfo (#5535)
- docs: update transparency report
- directory: process group deletion correctly, group of owners (#5540)
- core: support names with spaces in bot parameters (#5542)
- core: update simplexmq (reopenStore), fix postgres compilation (#5543)
- cli: require single quotes around names with commas (fixes names in bot parameters)
- directory: log superusers, admin users and owners group (#5547)
- core: Mobile.hs postgres interface (#5545)
- core, ui: support chat item TTL per chat and group aliases (#5415)
- core: simplexmq 6.3.0.2
- ios: update core library
- desktop, android: use timestamp as file name for videos (#5539)

- android, desktop: support chat item ttl per chat (#5546)
- core: get group history faster (#5562)
- test: track query plans (#5566)
- core: update simplexmq
- test: track agent query plans (#5571)
- core: batch connection deletion events (#5573)
- media: SimpleX logos (#5577)
- Merge branch 'stable'
- core: role for full delete preference (#5572)
- ui: translations (#5575)
- website: translations (#5580)
- ui: remove duplicate localization
- ui: translations (fix) (#5582)
- core: update simplexmq
- core: member mentions, types and rfc (#5555)
- android, desktop: refactor ChatView by reducing usage of derived state (#5589)
- core: update message text when forwarding and quoting to reflect changes in mentioned member names (#5586)
- Merge branch 'master' into mentions
- core: mentions in history, unread mentions in stats (#5594)
- Merge pull request #5588 from simplex-chat/mentions
- core: delete unused group contacts, don't create new ones (#5590)
- docs/servers: update installation instructions (#5561)
- Revert "ui: disable report item feature (#5498)"
- scripts: sqlite to postgres migration instruction (#5504)
- core: optimize group deletion (#5565)

- update library

- core: fixes for mentions (initial chat load, update mentions, markdown) (#5603)

body.name: v6.3.0-beta.1
body.body:
New v6.3.0-beta.1:
- forward compatibility with reporting content to group owners and admins.
- rename media file when forwarding them, to improve privacy.
- an option to confirm opening web links from chat list, defaults to "ask".
- show when files or group links blocked by server operators (with the new server version), to improve moderation transparency.
- fixes and UX improvements.

body.name: v6.2.3
body.body:
v6.2.3 has important fixes.

New in v6.2:

- SimpleX Chat and Flux (https://runonflux.com/) made an agreement to include servers operated by Flux into the app – to improve metadata privacy.
- Business chats – your customers' privacy.
- Improved user experience of chats:
  - Open chat on the first unread message.
  - Jump to quoted messages anywhere in the conversation.
  - See who reacted to messages.
- Improved iOS push notifications.

Read more: https://simplex.chat/blog/20241210-simplex-network-v6-2-servers-by-flux-business-chats.html

body.name: v6.2.0
body.body:
New in v6.2:
- SimpleX Chat and Flux (https://runonflux.com) made an agreement to include servers operated by Flux into the app – to improve metadata privacy.
- Business chats – your customers' privacy.
- Improved user experience of chats:
  - Open chat on the first unread message.
  - Jump to quoted messages anywhere in the conversation.
  - See who reacted to messages.
- Improved iOS push notifications.

Read more on December 10: https://simplex.chat/blog/20241210-simplex-network-v6-2-servers-by-flux-business-chats.html

body.name: v6.2.0-beta.1
body.body:
New in v6.2.0-beta.1:
- Flux (https://runonflux.com) - the second pre-configured operator in the app to improve metadata privacy.
- Improved chat navigation (Android/desktop apps):
  - Open chat on the first unread message.
  - Jump to quoted messages anywhere in the conversation.

Read more about how using several server operators improve privacy on Monday, Nov 25th, here: https://simplex.chat/blog/20241125-servers-operated-by-flux-true-privacy-and-decentralization-for-all-users.html

body.name: v6.1.0
body.body:
New in v6.1:

Better security:
- SimpleX protocols reviewed by Trail of Bits.
- security improvements (don't worry, there is nothing critical there).
  
Better calls:
- you can switch audio and video during the call
- share the screen from desktop app.
  
Better iOS notifications:
- improved delivery, reduced traffic usage.
- more improvements are coming soon!
  
Better user experience:
- switch chat profile for 1-time invitations.
- customizable message shape.
- better message dates.
- forward up to 20 messages at once.
- delete or moderate up to 200 messages.

The protocols review by Trail of Bits and release announcement will be published on October 14 afternoon here: https://simplex.chat/blog/20241014-simplex-network-v6-1-security-review-better-calls-user-experience.html
